search_text.description: Searches project files for a text substring. Returns the files with matches.

params.paths: Glob patterns relative to the project root that limit the search scope

search_regex.description: Searches project files for a regular expression match. Returns the files with matches.

params.paths: Glob patterns relative to the project root that limit the search scope

search_symbol.description: Finds classes, methods, and fields by name fragments.

params.paths: Glob patterns relative to the project root that limit the search scope

rename_refactoring.description: Renames a symbol and updates all references across the project.

params.pathInProject: Relative path to the file from the project root
params.symbolName: Name of the symbol to rename

move_method.description: Moves a Java method to another class, updating all call sites.

params.pathInProject: Relative path to the file from the project root
params.methodName: Name of the method to move
params.targetClass: Fully-qualified name of the destination class

extract_method.description: Extracts a code fragment into a new method in a Java file.

params.pathInProject: Relative path to the Java file from the project root
params.startLine: 1-based line number of the first selected line
params.endLine: 1-based line number of the last selected line

introduce_parameter.description: Replaces a local variable with a method parameter, updating all call sites.

params.pathInProject: Relative path to the Java file from the project root
params.variableName: Name of the local variable to replace

pull_up_method.description: Moves a method from a class to its superclass.

params.pathInProject: Relative path to the Java file from the project root
params.methodName: Name of the method to pull up

push_down_method.description: Pushes a method from a superclass to its subclasses.

params.pathInProject: Relative path to the Java file from the project root
params.methodName: Name of the method to push down

inline_method.description: Inlines a method body into all call sites.

params.pathInProject: Relative path to the Java file from the project root
params.methodName: Name of the method to inline

safe_delete.description: Deletes a symbol after verifying all usages can be resolved.

params.pathInProject: Relative path to the Java file from the project root
params.symbolName: Name of the symbol to delete
